why: The parallel Codex lineage suffered a rho/kappa conflation (its runner used the cross-campaign kappa value 0.75 as the within-campaign regime persistence rho, which is 0.90 everywhere in this programme), and its own instrument-failure record made the deeper governance point: a v2 freeze that omits rho is incomplete, because rho changes CAMPAIGN IDENTITY. This contract had the same omission. Its runner carries the correct rho = 0.90, verified by skeleton identity against the enumerated frontiers, so no campaign in this lineage is misconstructed and no result is invalidated. The omission is nevertheless closed here, because a parameter that determines which physical campaign is evaluated must be contracted, not merely coded.

campaign_identity_parameters_now_declare.note: kappa is NOT rho. kappa governs whether the latent regime carries from one campaign to the next; rho governs regime persistence between demand events INSIDE a campaign. Every enumerated 4^8 frontier, the frozen c256 Pareto and the C6 per-batch gate use rho = 0.90 with kappa as the stratum label.
